purpose: Exact preservation of PR4 behavior on one new ordered request trace under matching fresh-process startup. This does not establish HF correctness or prompt independence.

prior_results.A1_B1: Exact tokens, finish fields, top-five token sets and raw log probabilities; delta0
prior_results.A2_B2: Exact tokens, finish fields, top-five token sets and raw log probabilities; delta0
prior_results.selection_note: This supplemental test follows observed diagnostic matches. Its twenty new request positions have not been captured on either arm.

startup.intrinsic_server_warmup: Unchanged serving startup from the pinned source/config; retain logs and actual graph identities.
startup.model_requests_before_capture: None. Health checks are permitted. No manual probe, benchmark warmup, profiling request, or earlier user request.

capture.client: Use unchanged experiment.py capture with the explicit part file, then the next part.

comparison.client: Unchanged experiment.py compare, corresponding part1 and part2 only.
comparison.required_fields: Exact prompt IDs, generated token IDs, finish and stop reasons, top-five token sets, and raw log probabilities.

failure_policy: Retain every attempt. No request retries, prompt replacement, sequence shift, subsequence selection, or resetting between parts. Any request or comparison failure fails this supplemental gate. Record harness failures separately; do not discard them.
timing_separation: Use dedicated fresh correctness processes. Do not insert the new held-out prompts before the post-baseline timing control.
performance_policy: Retain the original workload,20 warmups,5 cohorts,statistics and thresholds. Replay original baseline prehistory including the five recorded repeat diagnostics before postbaseline timing. Record the original A/B prehistory difference as a control limitation; do not retroactively relabel diagnostic data.
publish_policy: A PR may claim exact preservation only on the recorded paired traces if both new comparisons pass. It must retain the original A/A failure and existing HF-accuracy limitation. Repeatable serving speedup still requires the unchanged performance gates, runtime/dispatch/compile evidence, postbaseline control, and independent final review. This supplement does not mark the original correctness gate passed.
